title: PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series 2026 Manila Leg Review
seo_title: PUMA PH Half Marathon Manila 2026 Review | SM MOA
meta_description: PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series 2026 Manila Leg review: October 11 at SM Mall of Asia -- the series' capital finale, open registration.
dek: Set for 11 October 2026 at SM Mall of Asia Complex, this Manila leg closes out RunRio's six-city PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series at the Philippines' largest shopping mall.
verdict: The Manila leg brings the PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series -- covered at its Clark and CDO stops elsewhere in this research -- to its capital-city finale at SM Mall of Asia. Three distances (21.1K/10K/5K), the same format used at every leg, and the same All-City Finisher Legacy Medal incentive for runners completing all six stops. SM MOA's scale (the Philippines' largest mall by floor area, on reclaimed Manila Bay land) gives this leg the most substantial single venue in the entire series. Registration is already open.

sections.heading: The Series' Capital-City Finale
paragraphs: The Manila leg takes place at SM Mall of Asia Complex in Pasay City, offering 21.1K, 10K and 5K distances -- the same three categories offered at every stop in the six-city PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series (Iloilo, Davao, Cebu, Clark, Cagayan de Oro, Manila). [1] Registration is currently open.

sections.heading: The Philippines' Largest Mall as a Venue
paragraphs: SM Mall of Asia sits within a reclaimed area along Manila Bay at the southern terminus of EDSA and is the largest shopping mall in the Philippines by floor area -- built to handle genuinely large crowds and events. [2] That makes it arguably the most substantial single venue in the entire PUMA series, similar to how the Decathlon Run and Sante Barley Trilogy's Manila leg also use SM MOA elsewhere in this research batch.

sections.heading: The Same Legacy Medal Incentive
paragraphs: As with the other legs in this series, all registered participants receive official PUMA race singlets and city-specific finisher medals, with an additional 'All-City Finisher Legacy Medal' reserved for runners who complete all six legs. [1] Completing the Manila leg as either your final or opening stop in that six-city journey carries the same series-wide incentive.

sections.heading: Standard Race-Day Rules
paragraphs: Only water is confirmed at hydration stations, walkers are permitted but asked to keep right, and wheelchairs, bikes, skates and strollers aren't allowed on course -- consistent with the rules across other legs in this series covered in this research. [1] Runners who don't start within 15 minutes of their assigned flag-off time face disqualification.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If you're completing the PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series' six-city circuit, or simply want a well-organised half marathon at the Philippines' largest and most accessible mall venue, the Manila leg on 11 October 2026 is a strong choice. Registration is already open.

faqs.question: What is the All-City Finisher Legacy Medal?
faqs.answer: A bonus medal for runners who complete all six legs of the 2026 PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series (Iloilo, Davao, Cebu, Clark, Cagayan de Oro, Manila), on top of each leg's own city-specific finisher medal and PUMA race singlet. [1]
